title: Prism Relay
tagline: Bend, split and filter light to wake every receiver.
description:
A light-routing puzzle campaign. Place mirrors, splitters and colour filters to guide coloured beams into receivers that each want an exact colour — sometimes a mix of two. Fifty levels across five chapters introduce reflection, colour mixing, beam splitting and white-light filtering, plus a fresh daily relay every day.

Every puzzle has a par: solve it with as few pieces and moves as possible to earn all three stars.
controls: Tap a cell to place the selected piece; tap again to turn it. Drag to move, drag off the board or long-press to remove. Keyboard: arrows, Enter, Delete, 1–5, Z undo, R reset.
